content.title: The UConn vs Michigan National Championship game is live streaming free tonight: Here’s how to watch
content.text: Michigan center Aday Mara (15) celebrates after Nebraska missed the final shot in the second half of an NCAA college basketball game in Ann Arbor, Mich., Tuesday, Jan. 27, 2026.(AP Photo/Lon Horwedel)If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveTonight’s electric men’s NCAA Tournament Championship game features Yaxel Lendeborg and the No. 1 seed Michigan Wolverines facing Alex Karaban and the No. 2 UConn Huskies, in a matchup that could be one for the ages. The tip is scheduled for Monday, April 6, at 5:50 p.m. PT / 8:50 p.m. ET (6:50 p.m. MT) with a live broadcast on TBS/truTV and streaming live on demand.Is the UConn vs. Michigan NCAA National Championship game on TV tonight, or streaming only? What time does it start?When: Monday, April 6, at 5:50 p.m. PT / 8:50 p.m. ET (6:50 p.m. MT)Where: Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, INTV Channel: TBS/truTVHow to watch streaming live without cable: There are several options to watch this game and more NCAA Tournament games this season.If you don’t already have cable, you can watch NCAA Tournament games live for free with DIRECTV (free trial). If you are all out of free trials or need a streaming service to watch games all the way through the NCAA Tournament, Sling is the cheapest way to watch every tournament game (costs just $23 for the first month). However, if your TV doesn’t already have one built in, you will have to buy an HDTV antenna to pair with your Sling subscription to get the games being broadcast on your local CBS station.If you already have cable, you can watch every NCAA Tournament game live through the March Madness Live app when you sign in with your cable provider login information.What are the latest betting lines for Michigan Wolverines vs. UConn Huskies?Spread: MICH -6.5Over/Under: 146.5 Get promo codes, signup deals, and free bets from our Oregon Betting News home page.Golden State Warriors vs LA Clippers is live streaming tonight — don’t miss it because of this one mistake Trail Blazers vs Spurs NBA Playoffs tickets are on sale now — Here’s where fans can get the best deals You can’t watch the Magic vs 76ers play-in game on regular TV tonight — here’s why John's focus is on helping readers find ways to watch live sports and experience them in person.
